consent.fallbackText:
With your permission, Nicx sends Falkyria **anonymous usage statistics**: which features you use, response times and error types.

We **never** send your conversations, files, name or e-mail. It is optional, and you can change your mind or delete the data at any time in **Settings → Privacy**.

section.title: Privacy
section.intro: Your conversations, files and memories stay on your computer. With your permission, Nicx sends Falkyria only anonymous usage statistics (features used, timings, error types), stored on servers in Brazil and deleted after 24 months.
